messages: Are there any parks in town, by chance?
There is one in the centre, one in the east, one in the north and two in the south. Will one of these work for you?
Could I get the address for the one in the centre?
Sure. The Cambridge University Botanic Gardens are located at Bateman Street.
i need its address and phone number.
The address is Bateman Street, postcode cb21jf and the phone number is 01223336265.
Thanks. I also need a place to get afternoon tea in the west.
There are no restaurants serving afternoon tea in the west.
How about Italian restaurants?
Yes I have two choices. One in the cheap price range and one that is priced moderately. Do you have a preference?
I don't have a price preference.  Which would you suggest?
Actually, I really like the la margherita - it's cheap but tasty. Would you like me to book it?
Yes, I need it for Friday, 20:00, for 7 people.  I need a reference number.  I need a taxi betweentwo places before 20:00.  Contact # and car type?
You're all set. The table will be available at 20:00 - they can only hold it for 15 minutes, though. Your Reference number is : 3V82NNNZ.
Thanks, please also help me find a taxi.
Okay! From where to where?
I'll be going from the park to the restaurant.
Be on the lookout for a Black Tesla. The contact number is 07533830631.
Ok, thanks so much for the help.
have a great day
I will with the lovely day planned. Thanks, again. Goodbye.
welcome and welcome anytime.
I'm looking for a pool somewhere in the south of Cambridge.
I'm sorry, but it doesn't look like we have a pool that matches your criteria.
How about some type of theater?
The Junction theatre is in the south area. Would you like the address?
Yes, please provide the address and postcode as well.
The Junction Theatre is located on Clifton way at postcode cb17gx. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Thanks. Yes, I also need to find a guesthouse for my stay there.
Are you needing the guesthouse in the south, also? Do you have a preference in price range?
The area should be the centre. I need it to be cheap and have free parking.
I have 2 guesthouses that fit your criteria. One is The Alexander bed and breakfast and the other is El shaddai.
What is the star ratings for them?
the Alexander Bed and Breakfast has a 4 star rating while the El Shaddai has 0 stars. Would you like to book a room with either of these?
Ok great, thank you.  I also need to book a taxi to get back and forth.
Where did you wan to leave from and go to?
I'll be leaving the theatre at 14:45 and going to the guesthouse.
Let's back up a moment. Which lodgings did you prefer, so we know where the taxi will be taking you?
Let's go with the Alexander Bed and Breakfast.
Your booking is complete, a grey volkswagen will be picking you up, contact number 07753429052. Can I help with anything else?
Cool beans! Sorry I was so much trouble. Thanks so much for all of your help, you need a raise dealing with customers like me!
It was no trouble at all! I hope you have a fantastic trip and enjoy your stay!
Hello, I am looking for a restaurant in the town centre that serves British food.
There are 7 restaurants in the centre of town that serves British food. Is there any particular price range you are looking for?
Yes, I'm looking for a moderately priced restaurant with British food.
I can recommend Restaurant One Seven. Would you like to book a table with them?
Sure. I will be booking 3 people at 17:45 on Wednesday. Could i also get the reference number, please?
Your reservation is complete for a party of 3 at 17:45 at a British Restaurant  One Seven in centre, and your confirmation # is VLJLK60E.
I also need a hotel in the same price range as the restaurant.
There are 18 hotels in the Moderate price range, would you like me to narrow these down by searching other amenities or location?
I would like something that is 2 stars and includes free parking.
I have 2 options with those specifications. The Ashley Hotel and the Lovell Lodge both with free wifi and parking. Which would you prefer?
Could you book a room for 2 people, 2 nights on Wednesday at the Ashley, please?
Book was unsuccessful. Would you like to try the lovell lodge?
Sure, lets try that instead.
I was unable to book the Lovell Lodge for you on Wednesday. Do you want to try a different day or a shorter stay?
Can you try the Lovell Lodge for the Wednesday, please?
I am sorry. Lovell Lodge still has no bookings available for wednesday. Would you like to try a different hotel?
Yes, I need a 2 star hotel for 3 people for 2 nights on  Wednesday, moderately priced, with free parking.
OK, I have you booked in the Ashley hotel. The Reference Number is : KEH2F5Z2. Can I help you with anything else today?
I think that's all I need. Thank you.
My pleasure, enjoy your trip.
Hi, I'm looking for a place to eat some indian food.
Do you have a price range in mind?
I would like it to be expensive.
I have several great options. Did you have an area of town in mind?
I'd like a place in the south, please.
taj tandoori is the place you want to go.  It meets all of your needs.  Need a table?
No, but can you give me the address, postcode, and phone number?
Of course, the address is 64 Cherry Hinton Road Cherry Hinton and their postcode is cb17aa. Their phone number is 01223412299
I would also like to go to some attractions in the same area as the restaurant.
There are a number of attractions in the area.  There's a cinema, a museum, a nightclub, some parks, a theatre... Do any of these appeal to you in particular?
restaurant is what i am looking for, entrance fee and postcode please. get me a taxi from the attraction by 10.15, get me its contact number and car type.
Just to clarify you are looking for another restaurant and not an attraction?
Oh, yeah, I do want information on attractions! In the same area. After that, I will need a taxi.
If you like parks the Wandlbury Country Park has free admission and is in the cb223ae postcode. Or I can tell you about the other attractions?
That sounds wonderful, is it also in the South part of town?  If so, I'd like a taxi from there to my hotel.
Yes, Wandlebury Country Park is in the south.  In order to help you book a taxi between the park and your hotel, I need to know what hotel you're at.
I want a taxi from the restaurant that I am at
Ok, so you'd like a taxi from the restaurant to the park?  Could you please let me know your desired departure and arrival times?
I'm sorry, I'd like a taxi from Wandlebury Country Park to Taj Tandoori. I'd like the taxi to pick me up at 10:15.
Okay, I have booked a taxi for you It will be a white Tesla and the contact number is 07162438055. Would there be anything else?
No, that is all. Goodbye!
Thanks for using Cambridge TownInfo centre, goodbye!
I am looking for a place to stay in the north of the city.  I would prefer a 4 star hotel please.
There are several guesthouses available.  Do you have a price reference?
No price preference needed
The home from home guesthouse hotel is located in the north, has a 4 star rating, and is moderately priced. Would you like me to book it for you?
Does it have free wifi?
How about the Avalon guesthouse?
I think that would be fine.
What day would you like to stay? How many days?
I would like it book for Sunday for 5 people and 3 nights. Can I have the booking number please.
The hotel is booked and your reference number is 0DJU3C37.  Can I help you with anything else?
I also need a train that departs from cambridge.
What is your desired destination?
I would like to visit Leicester on Wednesday.
There are 19 trains to Leicester on that day. Do you know what time you'd like to leave or arrive by?
I need to be in Leicester by 19:15.
Train TR1745 will get you there by 19:06. Do you want tickets for that?
I need the departure time for that train.
No problem!  The departure time for TR1745 is 17:21.  Will that work?
What is the price for that train?
It is 37.80 pounds per person.
Thank you, I think that is all I need for today.
Great! Hope you enjoy your trip!
Hi, can you help me find a train from Cambridge to Birmingham New Street?
Sure I can help you get tickets, any particular day and time that you had in mind?
Yes. I want to leave on Tuesday, after 9:15.
TR4567 will leave at 10:01, would that work for you?
Thank you that will work fine for me and my husband
Would you like me to book 2 tickets for you on TR4567?
The booking will be for only one person, and can I please have a reference number as well?
Yes.  The booking was successful, the total fee is 75.09 GBP payable at the station. Reference number is : DZJ8VE7A.
I'd also like to find a 4 star hotel with free wifi, please.
There are 3 hotels which are 4 stars, two in the west and one in the centre. Is there an area which you prefer?
Oh, I completely forgot to mention that I will also need a hotel that has free parking. Any of the 7 you said have this option?
huntingdon marriott hotel, the cambridge belfry and university arms hotel all meet your needs.  Would you like to book one of these?
Can you please tell me the price range and post code of the Cambridge Belfry?
The Huntingdon Marriott postcode pe296fl and the University Arms postcode cb21ad are expensive, but the Cambridge Belfry postcode cb236bw is cheap. Which one do you prefer?
Can you tell me your favorite of those 3 and let me know what are of the city that one is in?
My favorite is Huntingdon Marriott Hotel, it is located in the west area. Would you like me to book this one?
No, I just need to know the price range, postcode and area.
It is in the expensive price range, postcode is pe296fl, and it is in the west part of town.
Got it! Thanks a lot. That's it for today. Have a nice day. Bye.
You're welcome, have a nice day.
I need to find a place to stay that includes free parking and is moderately priced.
I have many guesthouses and hotels available. Do you have a preference on the number of stars or location?
No star preference, but I would like it to be a hotel type.
There are two hotels that fit your criteria: the Ashley Hotel and the Lovell Lodge. Which would you prefer?
The Ashley Hotel will do fine.  Can you book me a room there?  It will just be myself staying.
How many days would you be staying there?
id be staying for 3 nights
Perfect, and what day will you be arriving?
I'll be arriving on Monday.
Booking was successful. Reference number is : TY5A2H5O. Is there anything else I can help with?
Yes, I'm interested in knowing what attractions are in the area as well.
In the north we have riverboat georgina, milton country park, jesus green outdoor pool, and kings hedges learner pool. Do any of these sound good?
I am interested in visiting one of the colleges actually.
Unfortunately there are no colleges located in the north area of the city. Would you like to try another area of town?
Yes please. Any area would be fine so long as its a nice college to visit. Would you recommend the best one?
Personally, I'd recommend Christ's College in the Centre.  The entrance fee there is free.
That sounds perfect! Can I have their phone number, please?
Yes, their phone number is 01223334900. May I help with anything else?
No, you have been very helpful. Thank you.
You're welcome. Goodbye.
I am looking for a museum in the west to go to.
There are 7 museums in that area, did you want something with no entrance fee?
Yes, please. Can I get the address and postcode?
There are six free museums in the area. Are you interested in archeology, art exhibits or galleries? There is also a Cafe gallery.
I am most interested in a museum. Can you send me postcode and address. I also would like a cheap catalan restaurant, please.
Well, we have many museums. The Cambridge and County Folk Museum, for instance. Or the Museum of Classical Archaeology. What interests you?
I'll try the Folk Museum. Where can I find it?
The Cambridge & County Folk Museum costs 3.50 pounds entrance and is located at 2-1 Castle Street. Their phone number is 01223355159.
Could you also provide the museum's postcode please?
Yes, the post code is cb30aq
I'm also looking for a cheap Catalan restaurant.
I'm sorry, we don't have one. Will some other type do?
Yes, can you find a Chinese food restaurant in that post code instead?
I'm sorry, we don't have one. Will some other type do?
Are there any Italian places in town?
There is one Italian restaurant located in the same area as the museum. It is called the La Margherita. Would you like to book a table?
Yes.  Could you book a table for 8 at 13:15 on monday?
I just completed your booking. The table will be reserved for 15 minutes and the reference number is GEW1ENH5. Is there anything else I can help you with?
Yes, I want to book a taxi to commute between the two places please.
Great!  I have booked your taxi for you.   It will be a white volvo and the contact number is 07828251776.
Will the taxi be able to get us to the restaurant on time?  Thanks for all your help!
The taxi will be available and we hope you enjoy your trip.
Thanks for all your help!
You're welcome. Goodbye.
Hello, I am looking for a restaurant called meze bar.
sure, what would you like to know about it?
Well, I was interested in booking a table for Thursday.  Coul you help me with that?
Definitely! What time do you want to eat, and how many will be in your party?
There will be 6 of us and we would like to eat at 18:30 if possible.
Today at 18:30 for 6 at Meze. Is that correct?
yes on thursday
Booking was successful. The table will be reserved for 15 minutes. Your reference number is FVVICA5M. Will that be all?
I will also need train tickets.
Where is your destination?
I would like to go to Cambridge.
Where will you be departing from?
leaving bishops stortford and I'll need the departure time too please
how about TR2061? it leaves at 05:29
That sounds good. It leaves on thursday right?
I found the TR0798 which leaves on thursday and arrives at 10:07 giving you plenty of time to get into town for your reservation. Would you like to book tickets?
No booking for now, I just need the departure time.
The departure time is 9:29. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
No, I think I've covered it all.
OK. If you do think of anything else you need just let me know.
I would like to see some general information for king's college please.
King's College is a college and is located in the centre of town. There is no entrance fee.
Could you please send me the phone number?
Their phone number is 01223331100. Is there anything else I can do for you?
I am also looking for an expensive restaurant in the centre.
Sure, I can help you with that. Are you in the mood for a certain type of food?
Yes something creative and unusual.
I did not find any creative restaurants. Give me a moment and I will search for unusual ones.
Thank you.
Well, I hesitate to call it unusual, but perhaps you haven't had Turkish cuisine before? The Meze Bar Restaurant is delicious.
If you aren't able to find creative food, how about an indian one instead?
There are 6 indian restaurants located in the centre area. Would you like more information on one? I've heard the golden curry is good.
Please book Golden Curry for 2
What day and time would you like to book your reservation?
I actually need the reservation for 7 people please, at 14:15 on Tuesday.
Sorry that is not available, perhaps at another time?
how about for 13:15?
I was able to book your table.  Your reference number is AU4BERTG.  Anything else?
I think that's everything. Thank you.
Thank you for using the Cambridge TownInfo centre. Goodbye!
I can't wait to see some of the local attractions when I get there.  I'm looking for some places to go in town.
What types of attractions are you interested in?  We have everything from art galleries to zoos!
Hello. I'm excited to visit Cambridge. Can you give me addresses and phone numbers of different types of attractions in the centre of town?
What type of attractions are you looking for?
Well, something in the center... can you recommend anything?
there are lots of architecture in the centre of town how may I be of assistance?
Something you think is the best. Please give me some info on your favorite place.
Old Schools  is nice. Would you like more info on it?
Where is that located?
It is in the centre of town.
Can I have the address and phone number, please?
It is located on Trinity Lane and the phone number is 01223332320. The exact address isn't listed. Is there anything else I can help with today?
Yes, I also need a place to stay in the same area as the attraction with free parking.  It should be cheaply priced and 0 stars.
Well the el shaddai fits your needs. It isn't the best guesthouse in town but it will get the job done. Would you like to book it?
No, i dont need it booked. But i do need to know if it has free internet, the phone number, and the post code.
Yes it is free internet, the phone number is 01223327978, and the postcode is cb11eg. Is their anything else I can help you with?
Yes, I'll need to book a taxi to commute between Old Schools and the hotel. I'd like to leave be picked up at Old Schools by 8:15.
Ok. A blue skoda will pick you up at 08:15.  The contact number is 07568386559.
You were a great help! Thank you.
You're welcome! Can I help you with anything else?
No that is it for now. Bye.
I hope your trip is fun. Good day.
thanks again for helping
Thank you for letting me help you today.
I want to find a moderately priced restaurant.
I have many options available for you! Is there a certain area or cuisine that interests you?
Yes I would like the restaurant to be located in the center of the attractions.
There are 21 restaurants available in the centre of town. How about a specific type of cuisine?
i need to know the food type and postcode and it should also have mutliple sports
I am sorry I do not understand what you just said. Please repeat in a way that makes sense.
get me the food type and the post code
My favorite it The Copper Kettle at 4 Kings Parade City Centre CB21SJ.  It serves British food.  Does that interest you?
Absolutely! Thank you! I also need information on the attractions that have multiple sports in town, in the same area as the restaurant please.
The only multiple sports attraction is located in the east of town. Would you like more information?
No, I want to be in the centre of town. What about architecture attractions?
All Saints Church is an architectural attraction. It is in the Centre of town and entrance is free!
Can I get their phone number and address please?
Their phone number is 01223452587. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Oh, what type of architecture is it?
it is architecture type. anything else?
Just the address please
it is located in Jesus lane
Is there an entrance fee?
The entrance fee is free. Anything else i can do for you today?
That will be all. Thank you!
Thank you and have a great day. Goodbye.
I am trying to find a train leaving after 14:45 that's heading out from London Liverpool Street. What do you have?
There are 45 trains that fit your criteria. Please clarify your destination, day of travel and the time you want to arrive by so that i can narrow it down
I need a train to Cambridge on Tuesday.
I have five departures fitting your criteria on the :39 of the hour from 15:39 to 23:39. Would you like me to book any of these for you?
Yes please do book the 15:39
Great, that's train TR5245, leaving london liverpool street going to cambridge at 15:39. I booked 1 ticket for you which is payable at the station.
Thanks! I'm also looking for an expensive restaurant in the center of town.
There are 33 restaurants that match that criteria, what type of food do you wish to eat?
i am looking for something that serves italian cuisine
There are four Italian restaurants, would you like their names?
So long as they're expensive,  and in the center of town, I would, thank you.
They are all expensive. There is Stazione, Clowns Cafe, Don Pasquale Pizzeria, and Caffe Uno.
Ok, thank you. One more thing. What was the price of the train ticket?
The total fee for the train is 16.6 GBP payable at the station. Anything else I can help you with?
No, that will be all. Thanks.
Okay I am glad I could be of assistance. Don'y hesitate to call us again.
Thank you very much. I will let you go now.
Thank you very much.
I appreciate the help.
Thank you for contacting Cambridge Towninfo Centre
Yes I am looking for a place to eat in south Cambridge that is more on the expensive side.
Yes there are 5 different places that serve 4 different types of food.
I would prefer vegetarian food.
Unfortunately, there is no expensive vegetarian restaurant in that area. Would you like to look for something else?
I would like to try chinese food then.
Peking Restaurant is a great place. Can I book a table there for you?
I want a table for 6 people at 11:30 on tuesday.
Booking was successful for peking restaurant. The table will be reserved for 15 minutes. Your reference number is SDU5RA0N. Do you require any further assistance?
Yes I'm also looking for a train to arrive at 8:15
From where will you be departing? And how many will be traveling?
I will be departing from London Kings Cross and need to arrive in Cambridge by 08:15.
I would be happy to assist you.  I will need to know what day you'd like to depart before booking.
I will be departing Tuesday.
There are two trains available. One leaves at 5:17 and the other leaves at 7:17. Which would you prefer?
Actually I am departing from London Liverpool Street. I need a train to Cambridge on Tuesday that arrives by 8:15.
There is a train that gets in at 7:07. Would you like to purchase tickets?
How much does the ticket cost?
Tickets cost 16.60 pounds per ticket.
Great. Thank you very much for your help today.
You're welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with? I can help you create a booking for the train.
I'm looking for a restaurant that serves vietnamese food on the south side of town, is there anything like that?
There are no Vietnamese restaurants on the south side but there is one on the west side. Would that suffice?
What about on the east side? I would like for it to be expensive.
I'm sorry but there are not any Vietnamese restaurants on the East side of town, either.
Bummer, how about Indian food on the east side? I'm willing to pay for an expensive meal, if it's good!
There are 4 Indian restaurant on the East side ranging from moderately priced to expensive. Do you have a price preference?
Expensive would be fine. Can I have the address for the most expensive Indian restaurant out of the four?
How about the Pipasha Restaurant? It is in the expensive price range and serves Indian food. Their address is Newmarket Road Fen Ditton.
I would also like to check on museums on the east side. Can you see what you have in that area?
I have found four museums.  3 of them are free and one costs 5 pounds.  Can I get you more information on any of them?
I need information on all of them please.
What information would you like? The phone number, address, or postcode?
the address please
I can give you the address for only one, is there one in particular you wish to learn more about?
Give me information on the one closest to Pipasha Restaurant.
They are all in the same general area, but Cambridge Artworks is nice. It is located at 5 Greens Road, cb13ef. You can call them at 01223902168.
Cool! Is that one of the free ones? Gotta save my money for the grub, you know.
Cambridge artworks is free.
Perfect! Thank you so much for your help!
Anything else I can do for you?
It's Sunday and I am bored. Do you have any trains into Cambridge today?
There are many trains, when would you like to depart?
I would like to leave from Kings Lynn after 9:30.
TR5928 leaves at 10:11, would you like me to book that for you?
Can you give me the price of a ticket?
Tickets are 7.84 pounds. Can I book that for you?
Great I also need to find a place to stay that doesn't need to have free parking and is in the cheap price range.
There are 33 hotels in the cheap range, any preference on area or anything else?
Cheap price range in the centre.
There are two choices. Alexander Bed and Breakfast and El Shaddai. Do you want to make a reservation at one of these choices?
I will take Alexander please.
To confirm you want me to book you a room at Alexander Bed and Breakfast starting on Sunday. How many nights will you be staying?
Yes. Please book it for 2 people for 2 nights on Sunday.
I'm sorry, Alexander Bed and Breakfast is unavailable for those nights. Would you like to try another day or just one night instead?
Actually, let's back up. I need a place with a star rating of 0, in the centre, with free parking. Does the Alexander have 0 stars?
I have the El Shaddai that is cheap and located in the centre. They have a 0 star rating and offer free parking and free wifi. Would that work for you?
Yes, that would work for me. Please book it for 2 people for 2 nights starting sunday.
I'm sorry i was unable to book your table for 2 people for 2 days on sunday. Would you like another day?
How about trying just for one night, instead?
Booking was successful for 1 night only. Reference number is : O1RX0UHA. Can I be of anything further assistance?
No, that will be all.  Thank you for all of your help!
have a nice day, good bye.
I need to find a guesthouse in the north.
I have about 11 different options. Do you have a preference on price range?
I would prefer that be expensive.
There are no expensive guesthouses however I do see moderate ones. Would you like to try one of those?
Yes,but needs to be a 4 star in the north
ok, there are 7 options. Would you like free internet or parking?
Doesn't matter. Book one of them for myself and 3 nights starting from wednesday.
Booking at the Acorn Guest House was successful, the reference number is O4BO1B0L. It is located at 154 Chesterton Road, Postal Code cb41da. Is there anything else I can help with?
Yes, can you help me find a train?
I can. All I need is your departure location, destination, day and when you would like to either leave or arrive by.
I will be leaving birmingham new street the same day as my hotel booking.

Booking was successful, the total fee is 75.09 GBP payable at the station .
Reference number is : QRZK7Y5S.
Wow.  You didn't even get the timeframe I am looking for.  I can't leave until after 14:30.
I apologize! There are two trains leaving near your requested time. one at 14:40 and one at 15:40. Will one of those work?
The one at 14:40 should be fine.  Can you tell me when it arrives?
It will arrive at 17:23.
What is the travel time?
It's 163 minutes. Would you like to book some tickets?
Yes please, just one ticket would be fine.

Good news! Booking was successful, the total fee is 75.09 GBP payable at the station .
Reference number is : 3Q0TELMH.  Is there anything else that you need?
No thanks. That was all I needed. Have a good day
Enjoy your stay in Cambridge.  Bye.
I am looking for information in Cambridge
I can help book a hotel if you need it!
I'm actually looking for a train. I'm leaving from Cambridge on Friday.
I will be happy to help with that!  Where are you travelling to?
I need to travel to ely.
We have 10 trains going to Ely on Friday. Do you have a time you want to arrive or leave by?
I'd like to arrive by 18:00. Any that do that will be fine. I'll need a train ID, departure time, and travel time, please?
The TR5844 departs at 15:50 and has a travel time of 17 minutes.  Would you like me to book it for you?
Yes, 5 tickets. I also need a hotel in the north, free parking is not necessary.

Booking was successful, the total fee is 22 GBP payable at the station .
Reference number is : 8NJO8Q4C.
I am also looking for a place to stay in the north, no guesthouses, just hotels please.
I can help you with that. What price range are you looking at?
I don't care about the price and it doesn't need to have free parking.
May i suggest the Lovell Lodge. It's a moderate priced 2 star hotel in the north part of town with free parking and internet.
Sure, can you book it?
I sure can! Would you like to book rooms for 5 people?
Yes can you please get that booked for me.
When will you be arriving and how many nights will you be staying?
I am arriving on Friday.
how many days will you stay?
Sorry I do not need to make a reservation but I do need the postcode, phone number, and whether they have internet.
Their postcode is cb41sr and phone number is 01223425478. They offer free parking and internet. Is there anything else I can help you with?
Thank you, thats all I need today
I am happy to have met all your needs. Thank you for using Cambridge TownInfo Centre. Goodbye.
Hi, I'd like to find a place to stay that includes free wi-fi.
I have quite a few places that offer wifi, is there is a certain price range you are looking for?
Something cheap would be good.
I have about 10 different places. Do you have a preference on the area of town?
No not really. But I would prefer a hotel and like both free wifi and parking if possible.
The Cambridge belfry is a hotel in the west that is cheap and has both free internet and wifi.  Would you like to book this?
That's fine.  I'll need it for three nights starting on Sunday.
Unfortunately, that day doesn't work. Can we try booking another day or a shorter stay, perhaps?
Is there another hotel that matches that criteria?
Unfortunately that's the only hotel that suits your criteria.
I will try and restate so you can look again, I need free wifi and parking, cheap place, type of room does not matter.
There are 10 places that match your criteria.  What part of town would you like to stay in?
It doesn't matter. Whatever is available nearby will be fine.
I will give it a try again.  How many people will there be?
there are 4 of us.
You are booked at the Alexander B & B.  It is cheap, with wifi and parking included.  Your reference number is ZTRMOKWM. Is there anything else?
No. That is all!
Have a nice day and enjoy your stay.  Bye.
Thank you for your assistance.
You are welcome. Have a great time
Can you help me find a guesthouse in the north?
There are 11 guesthouses in the north. Do you have a price range?
No particular price range, but it should be 4 star rated.
Five of those guesthouses are rated four stars. Are there any particular commodities you need at the guesthouse?
I would like one with internet. What are the price ranges for those?
Actually, there are 8 guesthouses in the north with four stars and internet. 7 are in the moderate price range and one is on the cheaper side.
As long as it's a guesthouse in the north with 4 stars it'll be fine. Just recommend one to me please.
